name: Inner AI (app.innerai.com)
description: Inner AI — Brazilian multi-model AI chat platform (Inner AI Ltda). SPA frontend on S3/CloudFront, agentic-chat backend on platformapi.innerai.com/api + Centrifuge-style WebSocket realtime (chat-api-v3-ws.innerai.com/connection/websocket). 27 runtime models incl. gpt-5.6 family, claude-5, gemini-3.x, grok-4.x, deepseek-4, kimi-k3, llama-4, glm-5.3, sabia-4 and the fusion route 'inner-ai-assistant'. Catalog match: inner-ai kind=cookie credential 'token + email' == cookies token/email/deviceId read by the app's request interceptor.
author: ui2api capability package
siteVersion: app bundle assets/index-CNSyHRWx.js (16,063,595 B) + platform.innerai.com/login.0f167afe248f084794bb.bundle.js; SPA shell served by CloudFront from S3

transport.protocol: REST (axios JSON) on https://platformapi.innerai.com/api/ for CRUD + Centrifuge (bundled client) WebSocket at wss://chat-api-v3-ws.innerai.com/connection/websocket for realtime; legacy v2 chat API exists at https://chatapi.innerai.com/v2/ and https://chat-api-v2.innerai.com/v2/ (SSE, api_key + fake_imei headers) but the current agentic chat (v3) drives REST + Centrifuge
transport.realtimeUrl: wss://chat-api-v3-ws.innerai.com/connection/websocket (overridable by ws_url field of POST /api/v1/realtime/tokens response)
transport.channelNotes: Centrifuge connection_token + subscription_token granted per session via POST /api/v1/realtime/tokens {session_id} and POST /api/v1/realtime/tokens/history; exact subscription channel naming NOT yet captured (to verify on first live connection)

auth.scheme: custom headers USER-EMAIL / USER-TOKEN / DEVICE-ID injected on every API request
auth.tokenOrigin: cookies 'token', 'email', 'deviceId' (getCookie('token'|'email'|'deviceId') in request interceptor; mirrored in zustand useUserStore.credentials), matches provider-catalog credentialName 'token + email'
auth.refresh: not positively identified in bundle (session re-fetch on app boot POST /api/v1/users/me with cookies); token rotation/cookie-set to verify on first live capture

transport.streaming: agentic chat (v3): POST /api/v1/chat/messages returns {turn_id, assistant_message_id}; answer events pulled via GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/{id}/turns/{turn_id}/events (since_seq/limit pagination) pushed live over the Centrifuge subscription; STREAM_STALE_THRESHOLD_MS=120000, watchdog 15s; legacy v2 = EventSource SSE with email/token/api_key/device_id query params

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer (multi-model: 27 pickable models); answer streamed via Centrifuge WS turn-events subscription (v3 agentic chat), seq-paginated REST fallback GET …/turns/{turn_id}/events
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)
capabilities.implementation: POST https://platformapi.innerai.com/api/v1/chat/messages body {session_id, message, document_ids?, metadata{capability_hint?}} -> {turn_id, assistant_message_id}; realtime via Centrifuge on wss://chat-api-v3-ws.innerai.com/connection/websocket with tokens from POST /api/v1/realtime/tokens {session_id}; turn events REST fallback GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/{id}/turns/{turn_id}/events (since_seq, limit). Request/response shapes bundle-verified; exact subscription channel literal + event schema to verify live.

capabilities.name: Conversation history + CRUD
capabilities.description: List/get conversations and messages, cancel turns, list feedback reasons, post feedback (AgentChatAPI)
capabilities.implementation: GET /api/v1/chat/conversations (params), GET /api/v1/chat/conversations/{id}, GET …/messages/{message_id}, POST /api/v1/chat/turns/{turn_id}/cancel, GET /api/v1/chat/feedback_reasons, POST …/messages/{message_id}/feedback. Live shapes to verify on first authenticated call.

capabilities.name: Model catalog / picker
capabilities.description: Read the 27-model catalog and drive the picker (model id, llm_model slug, categories, pro/ultra gating)
capabilities.implementation: Public GET /api/v1/ai_models/index_unauthenticated (PRIVATE_KEY: 5xxiJxA7xC@jTLT4h, bundled literal) returns [{id, llm_model, name, ai_model_categories[], visible, can_use, pro_only, ultra_only, …}]; authenticated GET /api/v1/ai_model_categories(?category=). Picker writes localStorage llm_model + POSTs {ai_model_id}; fusion route llm_model='inner-ai-assistant', guest default fragment 'gemini-2.5-flash'. Endpoint verified live (200, 27 models).

capabilities.name: Uploads + artifacts (workspace)
capabilities.description: Attach files (multipart upload lifecycle) and read generated artifacts / workspace archive
capabilities.implementation: POST /api/v1/chat/conversations/{id}/uploads, POST /api/v1/chat/uploads/{id}/complete, POST …/uploads/{id}/cancel, GET …/uploads/{id}/content (blob, variant param); artifacts: GET …/artifacts, GET …/artifacts/{id}, GET …/artifacts/{id}/content (blob), workspace GET …/workspace + folder_archive {path}; jurisprudence GET …/jurisprudence/{id}. Shapes bundle-verified, live-to-verify.

capabilities.name: Realtime history events (Centrifuge)
capabilities.description: Live history invalidation via Centrifuge subscription (token: POST /api/v1/realtime/tokens/history); event literal 'history.conversation.deleted' seen
capabilities.implementation: createHistoryRealtimeToken() -> {connection_token, subscription_token}; Centrifuge WS; events include 'history.conversation.deleted'. Channel name + full event set to verify live.

capabilities.name: Voice (TTS preview) + prompt enhancer
capabilities.description: Read voice catalog for pickers and call the prompt-enhancer lambda
capabilities.implementation: GET /api/v1/get_voices -> [{voice_id, names, previews[].voiceUrl}]; prompt enhancer: https://lambda.innerai.com/promptEnhancer. Guest/v2 chat had api-based TTS hooks in bundle; live-to-verify.

auth.note: provider-catalog: inner-ai kind=cookie credentialName 'token + email'. Confirmed: request interceptor reads cookies 'token', 'email', 'deviceId' and sets USER-TOKEN/USER-EMAIL/DEVICE-ID headers on every platformapi call (bundle-verified). Login UI = https://platform.innerai.com/login.html (inputs #email, #password, social Google/Microsoft/Apple). Guest mode exists (gemini-2.5-flash) but full chat needs a session. Exact cookie-set materialization to confirm on first live capture.

permissions: requires a real logged-in Inner AI session snapshot (cookies token/email/deviceId)
public model catalog readable without login (PRIVATE_KEY literal embedded in bundle)
Centrifuge channel names + turn-event schema unverified — confirm on first live capture
anti-automation posture unknown (no client bot wall at static layer; CloudFront+S3 behind, platformapi enforces 401 without credentials)
